prompt: Claisen condensation: 2 eq ethyl acetate + NaOEt. Draw the β-keto ester product (after acidic workup).
explanation: NaOEt deprotonates α-C of one ester → enolate attacks C=O of the second ester → loss of OEt gives β-keto ester. Then NaOEt deprotonates the acidic α-H (pKa ~11, flanked by two C=O) driving the reaction forward thermodynamically. Workup gives acetoacetate.
